jobs.prompt: Create ONE transparent RGBA prototype sprite master sheet, EXACTLY THREE separate full body sprites in one horizontal row, 3 columns x 1 row. First reference is the exact original FDICON group067 three-frame source. The second reference is STYLE ONLY, approved bottom large-head very short-body Q-style. Preserve the first reference's OWN visible face and silhouette, do not copy Ares or any named game character, do not invent an identity, original portrait, age or story. Keep original blue/cornflower-blue hair parted around a bare exposed warm tan forehead, small cool pale eyes with dark pupils, no facial hair, neutral serious closed mouth. No headband, no crown, no helmet. Very large head about two thirds of full height and extremely short body, very small original gray-green feet. Preserve the EXACT asymmetrical small body from the native reference: broad muted green shoulder-to-ground panel on VIEWER LEFT, small dark navy blue central torso, tiny vivid red lower waist triangle, dark navy sleeve and small exposed warm tan hand on VIEWER RIGHT. Keep these native visible shapes, do not invent armor plating, shield, sword, cape extension, extra equipment or ornaments. All three sprites face mostly FRONT like source; reproduce the three slight native head/body shifts, NOT a walk animation and NOT new side or back views. Same scale for all3, keep original grounded low silhouette and exact color placement. Clean bold dark contours, readable handpainted shading, large head and very short body matching approved style. Three evenly spaced cells, ample transparent margins around each sprite, absolutely no touching or cropped parts. True alpha0 outside and solid opaque interiors including dark hair and clothes; transparent background, no checkerboard, no ground shadow, no scenery, no text, no labels, no border, no grids, no glows. Prototype is only source-based anonymous art; do not incorporate the unrelated DATO067 dragon portrait.
